sentences.l2: 随着网络游戏日益普及，青少年长时间沉浸在虚拟世界中，不仅影响视力与睡眠，也可能削弱现实社交和学习动力。
sentences.l1: As online games become increasingly popular, teenagers immersed in the virtual world for long periods not only affect their eyesight and sleep, but may also weaken their real-life social interaction and motivation to study.

sentences.l2: 为了帮助未成年人合理安排游戏时长，许多平台开始推行游戏防沉迷机制，例如限制登录时间、设置每日上限，并通过身份验证减少深夜游戏。
sentences.l1: To help minors arrange their gaming time reasonably, many platforms have begun to implement anti-addiction mechanisms for games, such as limiting login times, setting daily limits, and reducing late-night gaming through identity verification.

sentences.l2: 家长在其中扮演着关键角色，他们既要控制孩子接触游戏的机会，也要避免简单粗暴地禁止，否则容易引发逆反心理。
sentences.l1: Parents play a key role in this: they must both control children's opportunities to access games and avoid simply and crudely banning them, otherwise it easily triggers a rebellious mentality.

sentences.l2: 更有效的做法是与孩子共同制定规则，明确每天可玩的时段，并用运动、阅读和家庭活动填补空白。
sentences.l1: A more effective approach is to set rules together with the child, specify the time slots in which they may play each day, and fill the gaps with sports, reading, and family activities.

sentences.l2: 这样，家长的控制不再只是限制，而是一种引导，帮助青少年学会自我管理。
sentences.l1: In this way, parents' control is no longer merely a restriction but a kind of guidance, helping teenagers learn self-management.
